subject: Pilot access continuity requested during PO clearance
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire@medicor.health>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medicor.health
Date: 2026-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot access — PO in flight, request to maintain access

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. We're excited to continue the pilot — the model latency and safety checks look promising for our triage workflow. That said, our procurement team is still routing the PO (vendor intake + SOC2 appendix) and it won't land this week as expected.

Would Redwood be open to keeping our pilot environment active for another 10 business days so our engineers can finish the integration checks? We're not asking for expanded seats, just a short continuity window and a small credit top-up if that's possible until the PO clears. If it helps, I've attached the signed SOW we already returned (initial-signed-sow.pdf).

Estimated PO approval: end of next week (9/17) per procurement.

If you need a procurement contact to coordinate paperwork, loop in procurement@medicor.health. Appreciate any help here — it would prevent us having to re-run long-latency experiments.

Thanks,
Claire Nguyen
Director, Data Science
Medicor Health

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>

Hi Claire —

Thanks for the heads up and for sharing the SOW. Totally understand procurement timelines — we've seen this with healthcare customers before. We can do a short "pilot continuity" arrangement to keep your environment live while the PO routes. Proposed terms:

- 14 calendar days of continuity access starting today (auto-expire 2026-09-25)
- 5k pilot credits applied to your org (non-transferable; intended to cover test runs)
- No change to onboarded seats or model quotas

If that works for you, I'll send a one-page continuity confirmation to sign (pilot-continuity-agreement.pdf) and enable the credits immediately so your team can resume work. Please confirm the PO ETA you mentioned (9/17) or update if it moves.

Marissa — can you provision the credit bucket and set the auto-disable so we don't overrun the account? Karthik — flag if there are any billing/legal items we should surface to procurement.

Claire, if procurement needs our SOC2 link or an invoice template, we can provide both — I included links below.

SOC2: https://redwood.ai/compliance/soc2
Invoice template & remit: https://app.redwood.ai/billing/invoice-template

Thanks — I want to keep your engineers moving.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
